# Enwise Insights & Advisory

> Enwise is a London-based advisory practice founded by Ronen Eyal. It helps B2B Fintech and SaaS companies fix and scale professional services, onboarding and implementation delivery. Operator-led, hands-on, no jargon.

Services are grouped under "Beyond the Noise": Beyond the Signals (2-day scaling-readiness check), Beyond the Symptoms (4-day root-cause diagnostic), Beyond the Words (execution of change) and Beyond the Change (governance and continuous improvement). Enwise also provides fractional Professional Services Director leadership.
